blocks.text: Revenue (kul aamdani) woh poori raqam hai jo karobar maal ya services bech kar kamata hai.
Misal: agar Lahore ki ek dukaan 100 school bags Rs. 500 har bag ke hisab se bechti hai, to revenue hoga:

Doosri taraf profit (munafa) woh paisa hai jo karobar chalane ke tamam kharche, jaise kiraya, tankhwahein aur maal ki qeemat, nikalne ke baad bachta hai. Agar dukaan ke kul kharche Rs. 30,000 hon to profit hoga:

blocks.alt: Do bars (sutoon) wala chart, khari axis (seedhi khari lakeer) par Rupay 0 se 50k. Baen taraf wala bar Revenue: Rs 50,000 (100 x Rs 500). Daen taraf wala bar usi unchai ka magar do hisson mein: neeche Kharche (costs) Rs 30,000 aur oopar Profit Rs 20,000. Dono bars ki choti ek dotted lakeer se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Revenue = kharche + profit: school bags wali dukaan ki misal (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono bars barabar oonche hain kyunke saari kamai (revenue) do hisson mein batti hai: pehle kharche (costs) poore kiye jate hain, jo bachta hai woh profit hai. Is liye profit = revenue - kharche = 50,000 - 30,000 = Rs 20,000.

Yeh program school bags wali dukaan ka revenue aur profit nikalta hai, aur yeh bhi batata hai ke kam az kam kitne bags bechne se kharche poore hote hain (break-even, yaani na munafa na nuqsan). bags_sold, price_per_bag ya costs badal kar Run karein; kharche revenue se zyada hon to nuqsan (loss) dikhega.

import math

bags_sold = 100
price_per_bag = 500      # Rs.
costs = 30000            # kiraya, tankhwahein, maal ki qeemat waghera

revenue = bags_sold * price_per_bag
profit = revenue - costs
print(f"Revenue: Rs. {revenue:,}")
if profit >= 0:
    print(f"Profit: Rs. {profit:,}")
else:
    print(f"Nuqsan (loss): Rs. {-profit:,}")
print("Kharche poore karne ke liye kam az kam", math.ceil(costs / price_per_bag), "bags bechne honge")

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Pakistan mein bohat se chhote karobar informal sector (woh karobar jo hukumat ke record mein darj nahi hote) mein kaam karte hain, yaani woh apna revenue aur profit hamesha hukumat ko nahi batate. Is wajah se economy (mulk ki maali halat) ka asal size maloom karna mushkil ho jata hai!

blocks.prompt: Agar dukaan 120 bags Rs. 500 har bag ke hisab se bechti hai aur kharche Rs. 35,000 hon, to revenue aur profit kitne honge?
